lines.en: Eight legs land in turn, quickly.
My abdomen carries colored patterns.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下一串小坑
lines.en: My steps leave a row of pocks in the sand.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子在沙上横挪
lines.en: I sidle sideways across the sand.
The jungle floor is covered in litter.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶跳到另一片
lines.en: I hop from leaf to leaf.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的热让我躲到阴影里
lines.en: The heat of the sand drives me to shade.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，随时准备跳
lines.en: I stop and start, always ready to leap.
My front legs are held high.

lines.zh: 我用丝探了探前面的地
lines.en: I test the ground ahead with silk.
Tiny steps at a high rate.

lines.zh: 我八条腿一缩，钻过石缝
lines.en: My eight legs fold; I slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 我沿着一道干裂的沙线走
lines.en: I follow a line of cracked sand.
Eight legs gather and spread in unison.
I pause and lift my forelegs.
I climb up along a grass root.
I raise my forelegs and pose.
My patterned abdomen rotates slowly.
I wait on the sand for a shadow.
This is near the beach, and warm.
All eight of my eyes look outward.
I do not build a large web.
I crouch under a leaf, hiding my colors.
An insect flies nearby.
I wave my forelegs slowly.
Sand clings to my legs.

lines.zh: 我等着一个能跳到的空当
lines.en: I wait for a gap close enough to leap.
My body is smaller than a palm.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，又落回原处
lines.en: I spring once and land where I was.
The surf is close.
I lift my head to you with eight eyes.
Your hand is much bigger than I am.
I am at your feet, very low.

lines.zh: 你还没看见沙上那点彩
lines.en: You have not seen the fleck of colour on the sand.

lines.zh: 我腹部上的颜色是给别人看的
lines.en: The colors on my abdomen are for others to see.
I curl my legs in.
If you move, I move.
My eyes do not judge distance well.
The beach is very bright.
I am watching the shadow by your feet.
I flip away.
Several legs curl in.

lines.zh: 我的腹部被压扁了一点
lines.en: My abdomen is a little crushed.
Panic makes me jump wildly.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩得我腿都弯了
lines.en: That stomp bent my legs.
I crawl under a stone.
What leaks from me is sticky.
I am still alive.
Do not stomp again.
I cannot leap; my legs tremble.
Small insects smell good.
You have no insects in your hand.
I cannot bite through this.
Lower it a bit.
I come near, then retreat.
This is not for eating, is it?
I only look; I do not move.
Put it on the ground and I will look again.
My fangs are small; only insects fit.
I prefer live ones.
I get knocked onto my back.

lines.zh: 我的腿收起来护住腹部
lines.en: My legs draw in to shield my abdomen.
Your toe grazed me.
I leap away and land a step off.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我几根毛
lines.en: That knocked some of my hairs off.

lines.zh: 我八条腿一收，滚进沙里
lines.en: My eight legs fold and I roll into the sand.
We kick sand up.
Do not swat at me.
I am up again quickly.
I hide under a stone.

lines.zh: 我会把腹部举起来给她看
lines.en: I raise my abdomen for her to see.
The brighter the color, the better.
I sway side to side, almost dancing.
If she stays, then I approach.
This is a dangerous business.
Whether it works is uncertain.
I am in no hurry; let me look first.
Dusk on the beach suits it best.
I raise two forelegs.
Color is my way of speaking.

lines.zh: 我两条前腿一合，抱住了
lines.en: My two forelegs close and hold it.
Too heavy; I cannot drag it.
I push it into the shade.
This does not look edible.
I walk half around it.
It rolled away.

lines.zh: 我吐丝把它缠在草根上
lines.en: I spin silk and bind it to a grass root.
Not mine; let it go.
Only small things suit me.

lines.zh: 我塞到石头底下，用沙盖住
lines.en: I tuck it under a stone and cover it with sand.
I fix on your moving foot.
I am at the edge of your shadow.
You should not have stopped on this sand.
I leap higher than you think.
My bite makes people convulse.
I am crouched low.
Even looking down you will not find me.
The colors here help me.
I have my launch point.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块沙，我起跳了
lines.en: This patch of sand under you: I am leaping.
I follow your shadow.

lines.zh: 你走了三步，我跟了两步
lines.en: You took three steps; I took two.
I hide behind a stone.

lines.zh: 沙地很软，我的脚印很快就平
lines.en: The sand is soft; my tracks fill in fast.
I wait for your foot to stop.

lines.zh: 从这个角度我能跳上去
lines.en: From here I can leap up.

lines.zh: 靴口和裤脚之间空着一截
lines.en: A bare strip shows between your boot and cuff.

lines.zh: 我心里的节奏越来越快
lines.en: My rhythm quickens.
Your boot blocks half of you.

lines.zh: 你脚尖再往这边挪半寸
lines.en: Shift your toes half an inch this way.
I leap up and bite.
The bite is small, but it convulses.
I rake once with a foreleg.
I spring in from the side.
That bit the edge of your boot.
I leap away again.
You cannot see me, but I am here.
The venom numbs my own fangs a little.
This is my territory.
Your calf keeps shifting.

lines.zh: 沙一松，我八只眼先出来
lines.en: The sand loosens; my eight eyes come out first.
The light on the beach is strong.
First I shake the sand off my legs.
There is shade back in the jungle.
Eight eyes, and they see much.
I back under a leaf.
The tide withdrew; the sand is wet.
Nobody has walked here.

lines.zh: 我的腹部在阳光下很亮
lines.en: My abdomen is bright in the sun.
I crawl in slowly.
Fire nears and my legs curl.
I fall from a height onto the sand.
Water flips me over.
The blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的腹部
lines.en: Something pierces my abdomen.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我腿都僵了
lines.en: That force stiffens every leg.
Hungry enough to bite the sand.

lines.zh: 雷打下沙地，我全身一缩
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and I clench.
There is no ground here to crawl on.
